title: workload.deployment.promoted v1 data
description: The completion event for a durable promote request. Carries the outcome the requester cannot get from a reply, and is joined to its request by the envelope `correlationid`. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

fromRevision.description: Revision the workload was on before the promote.

toRevision.description: Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome of the promote. `superseded` means a newer promote for the same target took over; the requester's work is done but not by this request.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason, required when `outcome` is not `succeeded`.
